G5259.def:
**ὑπό** (before smooth breathing ὑπ᾽, [[Mat.8.9|Mat.8:9]]b, [[Luk.7.8|Luk.7:8]]b; before rough breathing ὑφ᾽, [[Rom.3.9|Rom.3:9]] on the neglect of elision in Mt, Lk, ll. witha, [[Gal.3.22|Gal.3:22]], see WH, _App._, 146; Tdf., _Pr._, iv),
_prep. with genitive, dative (not in NT), accusative _
I. C. genitive, primarily of place, **under**, hence, metaphorically, of the efficient cause, **by**: after passive verbs, with genitive of person(s), [[Mat.1.22|Mat.1:22]], [[Mrk.1.5|Mrk.1:5]], [[Luk.2.18|Luk.2:18]], [[Jhn.14.21|Jhn.14:21]], [[Act.4.11|Act.4:11]], [[1Co.1.11|1Co.1:11]], [[Heb.3.4|Heb.3:4]], al.; with genitive of thing(s), [[Mat.8.24|Mat.8:24]], [[Luk.7.24|Luk.7:24]], [[Rom.3.21|Rom.3:21]], al.; with neut. verbs and verbs with pass, meaning, [[Mat.17.12|Mat.17:12]], [[Mrk.5.26|Mrk.5:26]], [[1Co.10.9, 10|1Co.10:9, 10]] [[1Th.2.14|1Th.2:14]], al.
II. C. accusative, **under**;
1. **of motion**: [[Mat.5.15; 8.8|Mat.5:15 8:8]], [[Mrk.4.21|Mrk.4:21]], [[Luk.13.34|Luk.13:34]]; hence, metaphorically, of subjection, [[Rom.7.14|Rom.7:14]], [[1Co.15.27|1Co.15:27]], [[Gal.3.22|Gal.3:22]], [[1Pe.5.6|1Pe.5:6]], al.
2. **Of position**: [[Jhn.1.49|Jhn.1:49]], [[Act.4.12|Act.4:12]], [[Rom.3.13|Rom.3:13]], [[1Co.10.1|1Co.10:1]], al.; hence, metaphorically, **under, subject to**, [[Mat.8.9|Mat.8:9]], [[Rom.3.9|Rom.3:9]], [[1Co.9.20|1Co.9:20]], [[Gal.4.5|Gal.4:5]], al.
3. **Of time, about**: [[Act.5.21|Act.5:21]]
III. **In composition**: **under** (ὑποδέω), hence, of **subjection** (ὑποτάσσω), compliance (ὑπακούω), **secrecy** (ὑποβάλλω), **diminution** (ὑποπνέω).
(AS)

G5258.def:
**ὕπνος**, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX for שֵׁנָה, חֲלוֹם, etc. ;]
**sleep**: [[Mat.1.24|Mat.1:24]], [[Luk.9.32|Luk.9:32]], [[Jhn.11.13|Jhn.11:13]], [[Act.20.9|Act.20:9]]; metaphorically, [[Rom.13.11|Rom.13:11]]†
(AS)

G5263.def:
**ὑπο-δείκνυμι **
[in LXX for נָגַד hi., etc. ;]
1. to show secretly.
2. **to show by tracing out; hence, generally, to teach, make known**: with dative of person(s), [[Luk.6.47; 12.5|Luk.6:47 12:5]], [[Act.9.16|Act.9:16]]; id. with inf., [[Mat.3.7|Mat.3:7]], [[Luk.3.7|Luk.3:7]]; before, ὅτι, [[Act.20.35|Act.20:35]]†
(AS)

G5204.def:
**ὕδωρ **
genitive,
ὕδατος, τό,
[in LXX chiefly for מַיִם ;]
**water**: [[Mat.3.16|Mat.3:16]], [[Mrk.1.10|Mrk.1:10]], [[Luk.7.44|Luk.7:44]], [[Jhn.4.7|Jhn.4:7]], [[Jas.3.12|Jas.3:12]], [[Rev.8.10|Rev.8:10]], al.; pl., [[Mat.14.28-29|Mat.14:28-29]], [[Jhn.3.23|Jhn.3:23]], [[Rev.1.15|Rev.1:15]], al.; βαπτίζειν (ἐν) ὕδατι, [[Mat.3.11|Mat.3:11]], [[Mrk.1.8|Mrk.1:8]], [[Jhn.1.26|Jhn.1:26]], al.; τ. λυυτρὸν τοῦ ὕ., [[Eph.5.26|Eph.5:26]] opposite to οἴνος, [[Jhn.2.9; 4.46|Jhn.2:9 4:46]]; αἷμα, [[Jhn.19.34|Jhn.19:34]], [[Heb.9.19|Heb.9:19]], [[1Jn.5.6|1Jn.5:6]] [[Jhn.5.8|Jn 5:8]] [[Mat.17.15|Mat.17:15]] [[Mrk.9.22|Mrk.9:22]]; πνεῦμα, [[Jhn.1.26, 31; 1.33|Jhn.1:26, 31 1:33]]; πνεῦμα καὶ πῦρ, [[Mat.3.11|Mat.3:11]], [[Luk.3.16|Luk.3:16]];ἐξ ὕ. κ. πνεύματος γεννηθῆναι, [[Jhn.3.5|Jhn.3:5]] metaphorically, of divine truth and grace (τ.) ὕ. (τ.) ζῶν, [[Jhn.4.10-11|Jhn.4:10-11]] (cf. [[Jhn.4.13-15|Jhn.4:13-15]]); τ. ὕ. τ. ζωῆς, of spiritual refresh­ment, [[Rev.21.6; 22.1, 17|Rev.21:6 22:1, 17]]
(AS)

G5266.def:
**ὑπόδημα**, -τος, τό
(ὑποδέω), [in LXX for נָעַל ;]
**a sole bound under the foot, a sandal**: [[Mat.3.11; 10.10|Mat.3:11 10:10]], [[Mrk.1.7|Mrk.1:7]], [[Luk.3.16; 10.4; 15.22; 22.35|Luk.3:16 10:4 15:22 22:35]], [[Jhn.1.27|Jhn.1:27]]; τ. ποδῶν, [[Act.7.33|Act.7:33]] (LXX) [[Act.13.25|Act.13:25]]†
_SYN._: σανδάλιον, q.v (AS)

G5257.def:
**ὑπηρέτης**, -ου, ὁ
(ὑπό + ἐρέτης, a rower) [in LXX: [[Pro.14.35|Pro.14:35]] (עֶבֶד), [[Wis.6.4|Wis.6:4]], al. ;]
prop., an under rower; hence, generally, **a servant, attendant, minister**: of a magistrate's attendant, [[Mat.5.25|Mat.5:25]] of officers of the Synagogue or Sanhedrin, [[Mat.26.58|Mat.26:58]], [[Mrk.14.54, 65|Mrk.14:54, 65]], [[Luk.4.20|Luk.4:20]], [[Jhn.7.32, 45-46; 18.3, 12; 18.22; 19.6|Jhn.7:32, 45-46 18:3, 12 18:22 19:6]], [[Act.5.22, 26|Act.5:22, 26]]; of the attendants of kings, οἱ ὑ. οἱ ἑμοί [[Jhn.18.36|Jhn.18:36]] of Christian ministers, [[Act.13.5; 26.16|Act.13:5 26:16]]; ὑπηρέται λόγου, [[Luk.1.2|Luk.1:2]] Χριστοῦ, [[1Co.4.1|1Co.4:1]] δοῦλοι κ. ὑ., [[Jhn.18.18|Jhn.18:18]]†
_SYN._: see: διάκονος (AS)

G5286.def:
**ὑποπόδιον**, -ου, τό
(ὑπό, πούς), [in LXX: [[Psa.99.5; 110.1|Psa.99:5 110:1]], [[Isa.66.1|Isa.66:1]], [[Lam.2.1|La 2:1]] (הֲדֹם) * ;]
**a footstool **(= cl. θρᾶνος): [[Jas.2.3|Jas.2:3]] metaphorically, [[Mat.5.35|Mat.5:35]], [[Mrk.12.36|Mrk.12:36]] (ὑποκάτω, WH, R, mg.), [[Luk.20.43|Luk.20:43]], [[Act.2.35; 7.49|Act.2:35 7:49]], [[Heb.1.13; 10.13|Heb.1:13 10:13]] (all, except Mt, l.with, from LXX, [[Psa.110.1|Psa.110:1]], [[Isa.66.1|Isa.66:1]]) (for exx., see Deiss., BS, 223).†
(AS)

G5228.def:
**ὑπέρ** (when following subst.—poët.—ὕπερ; so as adv., [[2Co.11.23|2Co.11:23]]),
_prep. with genitive, accusative _
I. C. genitive, primarily of place (rest or motion), **over, above, across, beyond**, hence, metaphorically,
1. **for, on behalf of**: of prayer, [[Mat.5.44|Mat.5:44]], [[Act.8.24|Act.8:24]], [[Rom.10.1|Rom.10:1]], [[Jas.5.16|Jas.5:16]], al.; of laying down life, [[Jhn.10.11|Jhn.10:11]], [[Rom.9.3|Rom.9:3]], al.; esp. of Christ giving his life for man's redemption, [[Mrk.14.24|Mrk.14:24]], [[Jhn.10.15|Jhn.10:15]], [[Act.21.13|Act.21:13]], [[Rom.5.6-8|Rom.5:6-8]], al.; opposite to κατά, [[Mrk.9.40|Mrk.9:40]], [[Luk.9.50|Luk.9:50]], [[Rom.8.31|Rom.8:31]].
2. Causal, **for, because of, for the sake of**: with genitive of person(s), [[Act.5.41|Act.5:41]], [[Rom.1.5|Rom.1:5]], [[Php.1.29|Php.1:29]], [[2Co.12.10|2Co.12:10]], al.; with genitive of thing(s), [[Jhn.11.4|Jhn.11:4]], [[Rom.15.8|Rom.15:8]], [[2Co.1.6|2Co.1:6]], al.
3. = ἀντί (see M, _Pr._, 105), **for, instead of, in the name of**: [[1Co.15.29|1Co.15:29]], [[2Co.5.15, 21|2Co.5:15, 21]] [[Gal.3.13|Gal.3:13]], [[Col.1.7|Col.1:7]], Phm 13 (cf. Field, _Notes_, 225).
4. In more colourless sense, = περί (M, _Pr._, l.with), **for, concerning, with regard to**: [[Rom.9.27|Rom.9:27]], [[2Co.1.6; 8.23; 12.8|2Co.1:6 8:23 12:8]], [[Php.1.7|Php.1:7]], [[2Th.2.1|2Th.2:1]], al.
II. C. accusative, primarily of place, **over, beyond, across**, hence, metaphorically, of measure or degree in excess, **above, beyond, over, more than**: [[Mat.10.24, 37|Mat.10:24, 37]] [[Luk.6.40|Luk.6:40]], [[Act.26.13|Act.26:13]], [[1Co.10.13|1Co.10:13]], [[2Co.1.8|2Co.1:8]], [[Eph.1.22; 3.20|Eph.1:22 3:20]], Phm 16, al.; after comparatives = **than** ([[Jdg.11.25|Jdg.11:25]], al.), [[Luk.16.8|Luk.16:8]], [[Heb.4.12|Heb.4:12]].
III. As _adv._ (see supr. ad init.), **more**: ὕπερ ἐγώ, **I more**, [[2Co.11.23|2Co.11:23]] in compounds, see: ὑπεράνω, ὑπερλίαν, ὑπερπερισσῶς.
IV. **In composition**: **over** (ὑπεραίρω), **beyond** (ὑπερβάλλω), **more** (ὐπερνικάω), **on behalf of** (ὐπερεντυγχάνω).
(AS)

G5273.def:
**ὑπο-κριτής**, -οῦ, ὁ
(ὑποκρίνομαι, which see) [in LXX [[Job.34.30; 36.13|Job.34:30 36:13]] (חָנֵף) * ;]
1. one who answers, an interpreter (Plat.).
2. a stage player, actor (Plut., Xen., al.). Metaphorical (in LXX and NT), **a pretender, dissembler, hypocrite**: [[Mat.6.2, 5; 6.16; 7.5; 15.7; 22.18; 23.13-15; 24.51|Mat.6:2, 5 6:16 7:5 15:7 22:18 23:13-15 24:51]], [[Mrk.7.6|Mrk.7:6]] [[Luk.6.42; 12.56; 13.15|Luk.6:42 12:56 13:15]].†
(AS)

G5219.def:
**ὑπακούω **
[in LXX: chiefly for שָׁמַע ;]
**to listen, attend, hence, **
(a) **to answer a knock at a door **(Plat., Xen., al.): [[Act.12.13|Act.12:13]]
(b) **to attend to, submit to, obey **(Hdt., Thuc., al.): absol., [[Php.2.12|Php.2:12]] with inf., [[Heb.11.8|Heb.11:8]] with dative of person(s) (Plat., al.; but more frequently with genitive), [[Mat.8.27|Mat.8:27]], [[Mrk.1.27; 4.41|Mrk.1:27 4:41]], [[Luk.8.25; 17.6|Luk.8:25 17:6]], [[Rom.6.16|Rom.6:16]], [[Eph.6.1|Eph.6:1]], 5, [[Col.3.20, 22|Col.3:20, 22]], [[Heb.5.9|Heb.5:9]], [[1Pe.3.6|1Pe.3:6]]; with dative of thing(s), [[Act.6.7|Act.6:7]], [[Rom.6.12; 10.16|Rom.6:12 10:16]], [[2Th.1.8; 3.14|2Th.1:8 3:14]]; before εἰς (by attraction, for dative; see _ICC_, in l), [[Rom.6.17|Rom.6:17]]†
(AS)

G5222.def:
**ὑπ-άντησις**, -εως, ἡ
(ὑπαντάω), [in LXX: [[Jdg.11.34|Jdg.11:34]], εἰς ὑ. (קִרְאָה), etc. ;]
**a going to meet**: εἰς ὑ. (see M, [[Pro.14.1-35|Pro.14:1-35]] n), [[Mat.8.34; 25.1|Mat.8:34 25:1]], [[Jhn.12.13|Jhn.12:13]].†
(AS)

G5278.def:
**ὑπο-μένω **
[in LXX chiefly for קָוָה, also for יָחַל hi., etc. ;]
1. in-trans., **to stay behind**: before ἐν, [[Luk.2.43|Luk.2:43]] ἐκεῖ, [[Act.17.14|Act.17:14]]
2. Trans.,
(a) with accusative, **to await, wait for**: [[Rom.8.24|Rom.8:24]] (Hom., Hdt., Xen., al.);
(b) **of things, to bear patiently, endure**: absol., [[Mat.10.22; 24.13|Mat.10:22 24:13]], [[Mrk.13.13|Mrk.13:13]], [[2Ti.2.12|2Ti.2:12]], [[Jas.5.11|Jas.5:11]], [[1Pe.2.20|1Pe.2:20]]; τ. θλίψει (dative of circumstance), [[Rom.12.12|Rom.12:12]] before εἰς, [[Heb.12.7|Heb.12:7]] with accusative of thing(s), [[1Co.13.7|1Co.13:7]], [[2Ti.2.10|2Ti.2:10]], [[Heb.10.32; 12.2-3|Heb.10:32 12:2-3]], [[Jas.1.12|Jas.1:12]].†
_SYN._: μακροθυμέω (see: ὑπομονή) (AS)

G5225.def:
**ὑπάρχω **
[in LXX for הָיָה, יֵשׁ, לוּן, etc.; τ. ὑπάρχοντα for מִקְנֶה, רְכוּשׁ, etc. ;]
1. to begin, make a beginning (Hom., Hdt., al.).
2. **to be in existence, be ready, be at hand **(Hdt., Thuc., al.): [[Act.19.40; 27.12, 21|Act.19:40 27:12, 21]]; before ἐν, [[Act.28.18|Act.28:18]]
3. **to be, prop, expressing continuance of an antecedent state or condition **(cf. Gifford, Incarnation, 11 ff.; MM, xxv): with, nom, pred., [[Luk.8.41; 9.48|Luk.8:41 9:48]], [[Act.4.34; 7.55; 8.16; 16.3; 19.36; 21.20|Act.4:34 7:55 8:16 16:3 19:36 21:20]], [[1Co.7.26; 12.22|1Co.7:26 12:22]], [[Jas.2.15|Jas.2:15]], [[2Pe.3.11|2Pe.3:11]]; ptcp. with pred., [[Luk.16.14; 23.50|Luk.16:14 23:50]], [[Act.2.30, 32; 17.24; 22.3|Act.2:30, 32 17:24 22:3]], [[Rom.4.19|Rom.4:19]], [[1Co.2.15|1Co.2:15]], [[2Co.8.17; 12.16|2Co.8:17 12:16]], [[Gal.1.14; 2.14|Gal.1:14 2:14]]; pl., [[Luk.11.13|Luk.11:13]], [[Act.16.20, 37; 17.29|Act.16:20, 37 17:29]], [[2Pe.2.19|2Pe.2:19]]; before ἐν, with dative of thing(s), [[Luk.7.25; 16.23|Luk.7:25 16:23]], [[Act.5.4; 10.12|Act.5:4 10:12]], [[1Co.11.18|1Co.11:18]], [[Php.3.20|Php.3:20]]; ἐν μορφῇ θεοῦ ὑπάρχων (R, mg., being originally), [[Php.2.6|Php.2:6]] ἐν, with dative of person(s), (among), [[1Co.11.18|1Co.11:18]] μακρὰν ἀπό, [[Act.17.27|Act.17:27]] πρὸς τ. σωτηρίας, [[Act.27.34|Act.27:34]]
4. **to belong to **(Thuc., Xen., al.): with dative of person(s), [[Act.3.6; 4.37; 28.7|Act.3:6 4:37 28:7]], [[2Pe.1.8|2Pe.1:8]]; τὰ ὑπάρχοντα, **one's belongings, possessions**: with dative of person(s), [[Luk.8.3; 12.15|Luk.8:3 12:15]], [[Act.4.32|Act.4:32]]; with genitive of person(s), [[Mat.19.21; 24.47; 25.14|Mat.19:21 24:47 25:14]], [[Luk.11.21; 12.33, 44; 14.33; 16.1; 19.8|Luk.11:21 12:33, 44 14:33 16:1 19:8]], [[1Co.13.3|1Co.13:3]], [[Heb.10.34|Heb.10:34]] (cf. προ-υπάρχω).†
(AS)

G5268.def:
**ὑπο-ζύγιος**, -α, -ον
[in LXX for חֲמוֹר ;]
**under the yoke**; as subst., τ . (Hdt., al.), a beast of burden; colloq., an ass (see Deiss., BS, 160 f.), and so always in LXX and NT: [[Mat.21.5|Mat.21:5]] (LXX), [[2Pe.2.16|2Pe.2:16]]†
(AS)

G5270.def:
**ύπο-κάτω ** _comp. adv._ (see M, _Pr._, 99),
[in LXX chiefly for תַּחַת ;]
**below, under**: as prep. with genitive, [[Mat.22.44|Mat.22:44]], [[Mrk.6.11; 7.28; 12.36|Mrk.6:11 7:28 12:36]] (Rec., R, txt., ὑποπόδιον, as in LXX), [[Luk.8.16|Luk.8:16]], [[Jhn.1.51|Jhn.1:51]], [[Heb.2.8|Heb.2:8]]" (LXX), [[Rev.5.3, 13; 6.9; 12.1|Rev.5:3, 13 6:9 12:1]].†
(AS)

G5272.def:
**ὑπό-κρισις**, -εως, ἡ
(ὑποκρίνομαι, which see) [in LXX: [[2Ma.6.25|2Ma.6:25]] * ;]
1. a reply, answer (Hdt.).
2. play-acting (Arist., Polyb., al.). Metaphorical, **pretence, hypocrisy**: [[Mat.23.28|Mat.23:28]], [[Mrk.12.15|Mrk.12:15]], [[Luk.12.1|Luk.12:1]], [[Gal.2.13|Gal.2:13]], [[1Ti.4.2|1Ti.4:2]], [[1Pe.2.1|1Pe.2:1]] (Polyb., Pss [[Sng.4.7|Sng.4:7]]).†
(AS)

G5214.def:
**ὑμνέω**, -ῶ
(ὕμνος) [in LXX for הָלַל pi., שִׁיר, יָדָה hi., etc. ;]
1. trans., with accusative of person(s) (in cl. also with accusative of thing(s)), **to sing to, laud, sing to the praise of**: [[Act.16.25|Act.16:25]], [[Heb.2.12|Heb.2:12]].
2. Intrans., **to sing**: in LXX and NT, of singing hymns and praises to God ([[Psa.65.13|Psa.65:13]], al.), [[Mat.26.30|Mat.26:30]], [[Mrk.14.26|Mrk.14:26]] (see Swete, in l).†
(AS)

G5265.def:
**ὑπο-δέω **
[in LXX: [[2Ch.28.15|2Ch.28:15]], [[Ezk.16.10|Eze.16:10]] (נָעַל) * ;]
to blind under, esp. of foot gear. Most frequently in mid, and pass. with accusative;
(a) of the foot, ὑποδησάμενοι τ. πόδας, **your feet shod**: [[Eph.6.15|Eph.6:15]]
(b) **of that which is put on, σανδάλια**: [[Mrk.6.9|Mrk.6:9]], [[Act.12.8|Act.12:8]].†
(AS)

G5243.def:
**ὑπερηφανία**, -ας, ἡ
(ὑπερήφανος, which see), [in LXX chiefly for גָּאוֹן and cogn. forms ;]
**haughtiness, arrogance, disdain**: [[Mrk.7.22|Mrk.7:22]] (Plat., Xen.).†
(AS)

G5276.def:
**ὑπολήνιον**, -ου, τό
(ὑπό, ληνός), [in LXX: [[Jol.3.13|Jol.3:13]] (4:13), [[Hag.2.17|Hag.2:17]], (16), [[Zec.14.10|Zec.14:10]], [[Isa.16.10|Isa.16:10]] (יֶקֶב) * ;]
a vessel or trough beneath a winepress to receive the juice (RV, a pit for the winepress): [[Mrk.12.1|Mrk.12:1]] (see Swete, in l, and cf. ληνός).†
(AS)

G5298.def:
**ὑπο-χωρέω **
[in LXX: [[Jdg.20.37|Jdg.20:37]] B (-), [[Sir.13.9|Sir.13:9]], [[2Ma.12.12|2Ma.12:12]] * ;]
**to go back, retire**: before ἐν, [[Luk.5.16|Luk.5:16]] before εἰς, [[Luk.9.10|Luk.9:10]]†
(AS)

G5240.def:
**ὑπερ-εκ-χύννω (Rec. -ύνω), late form of -χέω **
to pour out over. Pass., **to overflow, run over**: [[Luk.6.38|Luk.6:38]] (not elsewhere).†
(AS)

G5274.def:
**ὑπο-λαμβάνω **
[in LXX: [[Job.2.4; 4.1|Job.2:4 4:1]] and frequently (עָנָה), [[Psa.48.9|Psa.48:9]] (דָּמָה pi.), [[Tob.6.17|Tob.6:17]], [[Wis.17.2|Wis.17:2]], [[3Ma.3.8|3Ma.3:8]] [[3Mac.3.11|3Mac 3:11]], al. ;]
1. **to take or bear up **(by supporting from beneath): with accusative of person(s), [[Act.1.9|Act.1:9]]
2. **to receive, welcome, entertain **(Xen.): [[3Jn.8|III Jn 8]].
3. **to catch up in speech **(Hdt., al.; Jb, ll. with): [[Luk.10.30|Luk.10:30]]
4. **Of mental action, to assume, suppose **(Xen., al.; To, Wis, 3Mac, ll. with): [[Act.2.15|Act.2:15]] before ὅτι (see Bl., § 70, 2), [[Luk.7.43|Luk.7:43]]†
(AS)

G5264.def:
**ὑπο-δέχομαι **
[in LXX: [[Tob.7.8-9|Tob.7:8-9]] [[Jdt.13.13|Jdth.13:13]] A, [[1Ma.16.15|1Ma.16:15]], [[4Ma.13.17|4Ma.13:17]] * ;]
**to receive under one's roof, receive as a guest, entertain hospitably**: with accusative of person(s), [[Luk.19.6|Luk.19:6]], [[Act.17.7|Act.17:7]], [[Jas.2.25|Jas.2:25]]; εἰς τ. οἶκον, [[Luk.10.38|Luk.10:38]] (see MM, xxv).†
(AS)

G5299.def:
**ὑπωπιάζω**
(ὑπώπιον, (a) the part of the face below the eyes; (b) a blow on the face),
**to strike under the eye, give a black eye**:
metaphorically,
(a) of persistent annoyance (RV, wear out), [[Luk.18.6|Luk.18:6]]
(b) of severe self-discipline (R, txt. buffet, mg. bruise), [[1Co.9.27|1Co.9:27]] (see Field, _Notes_, 71, 174).†
ὑπο-πιάζω,
**later form of ὑποπιέζω, to press slightly**; metaphorically,
**to repress**: [[1Co.9.27|1Co.9:27]] T.7 for ὑπωπιάζω, which see†
(AS)

G5291.def:
**ὑπο-στρωννύω **
[in LXX: [[Isa.58.5|Isa.58:5]] (יָצָא hi.), etc. ;]
**late form of ὑπο-στορέννυμι, to spread or strew under**: with accusative of thing(s), [[Luk.19.36|Luk.19:36]]†
(AS)

G5271.def:
**ὑπο-κρίνομαι **
[in LXX: ([[Job.40.2|Job.40:2]]) אּ1 (AB אּ2 ἀπο-, עָנָה), [[Sir.1.29; 35.15|Sir.1:29 35:15]] (32:15) [[Sir.36.2|Sir.36:2]] (33:2), [[2Ma.5.25|2Ma.5:25]] [[2Mac.6.21|2Mac 6:21]] [[2Mac.6.24|2Mac 6:24]], [[4Ma.6.15|4Ma.6:15]] [[4Mac.6.17|4Mac 6:17]] * ;]
1. = Att.. ἀποκρίνομαι (which see), to answer, reply (Hom., Hdt., al.).
2. to answer on the stage, play apart (Arist., al.). Metaphorical, **to feign, pretend **(Demos., Polyb.): with accusative and inf., [[Luk.20.20|Luk.20:20]] (cf. [[Pss.4.22|Ps sol 4:22]]).†
(AS)

G5279.def:
**ὑπο-μιμνήσκω **
[in LXX: [[1Ki.4.3|3Ki.4:3]] B ( hi.), [[Wis.12.1; 18.22|Wis.12:1 18:22]], [[4Ma.18.14|4Ma.18:14]] * ;]
**to cause one to remember, put one in mind or remind one of**: with accusative of thing(s), [[2Ti.2.14|2Ti.2:14]], [[3Jn.10|3Jn.10]]; with dupl. accusative (Thus., al.), [[Jhn.14.26|Jhn.14:26]] with accusative of person(s), before περί, [[2Pe.1.12|2Pe.1:12]] id., before ὅτι, [[Jude.5|Ju 5]]; with inf., [[Tit.3.1|Tit.3:1]] pass., with genitive of thing(s), [[Luk.22.61|Luk.22:61]]†
(AS)

G5200.def:
**ὑγρός**, -ά, -όν,
[in LXX: [[Jdg.16.7|Jdg.16:7]],8 (לַח), [[Job.8.16|Job.8:16]] (רָשׂב), [[Sir.39.13|Sir.39:13]]
**wet, moist**, opposite to ξηρός: of wood, **sappy, green**: [[Luk.23.31|Luk.23:31]]†
(AS)

G5201.def:
**ὑδρία**, -ας, ἠ
(ὕδωρ), [in LXX for בַּד ;]
1. prop., **a water-pot** or **jar**: [[Jhn.2.6|Jhn.2:6]], 7 [[Jhn.4.28|John 4:28]].
2. More frequently in Attic = ἄγγυς, **a pot, urn or jar** of any kind, as for holding wine, coins, etc. (see Rutherford, _NPhr._, 23; MM, xxv).
† (AS)

G5262.def:
**ὑπό-δειγμα**, -τος, τό
(ὑποδείκνυμι), [in LXX: [[Ezk.42.15|Eze.42:15]], [[Sir.44.16|Sir.44:16]], [[2Ma.6.28|2Ma.6:28]] [[2Mac.6.31|2Mac 6:31]], [[4Ma.17.23|4Ma.17:23]] * ;]
used by later writers (Xen. onwards) for παράδειγμα (see Rutherford, _NPhr._, 62),
(a) **a figure, copy**: [[Heb.8.5; 9.23|Heb.8:5 9:23]];
(b) **an example**: for imitation, [[Jhn.13.15|Jhn.13:15]], [[Jas.5.10|Jas.5:10]]; for warning, [[Heb.4.11|Heb.4:11]], [[2Pe.2.6|2Pe.2:6]].†
_SYN._: ὁμοίωμα, τύπος, ὑποτύπωσις (see _DB_, iii. 696b) (AS)

G5253.def:
**ὑπερῷον**, -ου, τό
(neut. of ὑπερῷος, above, ὑπέρ) [in LXX for עֲלִיָּה and cogn. forms ;]
1. in cl., the upper story or upper rooms where the women resided (Hom., a1.).
2. **In LXX and NT, an upper chamber, roof-chamber, built on the flat roof of the house **(see _DB_, iii, 674a): [[Act.1.13; 9.37, 39; 20.8|Act.1:13 9:37, 39 20:8]] (cf. [[2Ki.23.22|4Ki.23:22]]).†
(AS)

G5223.def:
**ὕπαρξις**, -εως, ἡ
(ὑπάρχω), [in LXX for רְכוּשׁ, הוֹן, etc. ;]
1. subsistence, existence (Arist., al.).
2. **In late writers, = τὰ ὑπάρχοντα, substance, property**: [[Heb.10.34|Heb.10:34]] pl., [[Act.2.45|Act.2:45]]†
(AS)

G5260.def:
**ὑπο-βάλλω **
[in LXX: ??[[Dan.3.9|Dan.3:9]] A, I [[Est.2.18|Est.2:18]] * ;]
to throw or put under. Metaphorical,
(a) **to subject, submit**;
(b) **to suggest, whisper, prompt**;
(with) to suborn (see Field, _Notes_, 113), **instigate**: with accusative of person(s), [[Act.6.11|Act.6:11]]†
(AS)

G5255.def:
**ὑπήκοος**, -ον
(ὑπακσύω), [in LXX: [[Jhn.17.13|Jhn.17:13]] (לָמַם) [[Pro.21.28|Pro.21:28]] (שָׁמַע), etc. ;]
**giving ear, obedient, subject**: [[Php.2.8|Php.2:8]] with dative of person(s), [[Act.7.39|Act.7:39]] εἰς πάντα, [[2Co.2.9|2Co.2:9]]†
(AS)

G5282.def:
**ὑπο νοέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX: Da TH [[Dan.7.25|Dan.7:25]] (סְבַר), [[Tob.8.16|Tob.8:16]], [[Jdt.14.14|Jdth.14:14]], [[Sir.23.21|Sir.23:21]] * ;]
**to suspect, conjecture**: [[Act.25.18|Act.25:18]] with accusative and inf., [[Act.13.25; 27.27|Act.13:25 27:27]].†
(AS)

G5256.def:
**ὑπηρετέω**, -ῶ
(ὑπηρέτης) [in LXX: [[Wis.16.21, 24-25; 19.6|Wis.16:21, 24-25 19:6]], [[Sir.39.4|Sir.39:4]] * ;]
prop., to serve as rower on a ship (Diod., al.). In cl. always metaphorically, **to minister to, serve**: with dative of person(s), [[Act.13.36; 20.34; 24.23|Act.13:36 20:34 24:23]].†
(AS)

G5205.def:
**ὑετός**, -οῦ, ὁ
(ὕω, to rain), [in LXX chiefly for ;]
**rain**: [[Act.14.17; 28.2|Act.14:17 28:2]], [[Heb.6.7|Heb.6:7]], [[Jas.5.18|Jas.5:18]], [[Rev.11.6|Rev.11:6]]; ὄψιμος (which see), sc. ὑ., [[Jas.5.7|Jas.5:7]]†
(AS)

G5237.def:
**ὑπερ-εῖδον**, aor.
[in LXX for עָלַם hi., מַעַל, etc. ;]
**to overlook**: with accusative of thing(s), [[Act.17.30|Act.17:30]]
(AS)

G5288.def:
**ὑπο-στέλλω **
[in LXX: [[Deu.1.17|Deu.1:17]] (גּוּר), [[Job.13.8|Job.13:8]] (נָשָׂא פָּנִים), [[Hab.2.4|Hab.2:4]] (עָפַל pu.), [[Hag.1.10|Hag.1:10]] (כָּלָא), [[Exo.23.21|Exo.23:21]], [[Wis.6.7|Wis.6:7]], [[3Ma.5.28|3Ma.5:28]] * ;]
1. to draw in, let down (ἱστίον, οὐράν, etc.).
2. **to draw back, withdraw**: ἑαυτόν, [[Gal.2.12|Gal.2:12]] (Polyb., al.; see Lft., in l). Mid., **to shrink or draw back**: [[Heb.10.38|Heb.10:38]] (LXX); before τοῦ, with inf., [[Act.20.27|Act.20:27]] οὐδέν, [[Act.20.20|Act.20:20]]†
(AS)

G5284.def:
**ὑπο-πλέω **
to sail under, i.e. under the lee of: with accusative, [[Act.27.4|Act.27:4]], 7.†
(AS)

G5295.def:
**ὑπο-τρέχω **
**to run in under; of navigators, to run in the lee of**: with accusative (see M, _Pr._, 65), [[Act.27.16|Act.27:16]]†
(AS)

G5269.def:
**ὑπο-ζώννυμι **
[in LXX: [[2Ma.3.19|2Ma.3:19]] * ;]
**to undergird **(Hdt., al.; ὑπὸ τ. μάστους, 2Mac, l.with); of a ship, **to undergird or frap**: [[Act.27.17|Act.27:17]] (see _DB_, _ext._ 367a).†
(AS)

G5218.def:
**ὑπακοή**, -ῆς, ἡ
(ὑπακούω), [in LXX: [[2Sa.22.36|2Ki.22:36]] (עֲנָוָה); in Aq.: [[2Sa.23.23|2Ki.23:23]] * ;]
**obedience **(opposite to παρακοή);
1. in general, absol., εἰς ὑ., [[Rom.6.16|Rom.6:16]] with genitive subjc., [[2Co.7.15; 10.6|2Co.7:15 10:6]], Phm 21; with genitive obj., [[Rom.1.5|Rom.1:5]] (Lft, _Notes_, 246) [[Rom.16.26|Rom.16:26]], [[1Pe.1.22|1Pe.1:22]]; τ. Χριστοῦ, [[2Co.10.5|2Co.10:5]]
2. **Of obedience to God's commands**: absol., [[1Pe.1.2|1Pe.1:2]] opposite to ἁμαρτία, [[Rom.6.16|Rom.6:16]] τέκνα ὑπακοῆς, [[1Pe.1.14|1Pe.1:14]] with genitive subj., [[Rom.15.18; 16.19|Rom.15:18 16:19]].
3. **Of Christ's obedience**: absol., [[Heb.5.8|Heb.5:8]] with genitive subj., [[Rom.5.19|Rom.5:19]]
(The word is not found except in LXX, NT and eccl.).†
(AS)

G5267.def:
**ὑπόδικος**, -ον
**brought to trial, answerable to**: with dative of person(s), τ. θεῷ, [[Rom.3.19|Rom.3:19]] (see MM, xxv).†
(AS)

G5248.def:
**ὑπερ-περισσεύω **
**to abound more exceedingly**: [[Rom.5.21|Rom.5:21]] Mid., in same sense (RV, overflow): with dative of thing(s), [[2Co.7.4|2Co.7:4]]†
(AS)

G5220.def:
**ὕπανδρος**, -ον
[in LXX: [[Num.5.20, 29|Num.5:20, 29]] (אִישׁ תַּחַת), [[Pro.6.24, 29|Pro.6:24, 29]], [[Sir.9.9; 41.21|Sir.9:9 41:21]] * ;]
**under or subject to a man, married**: γυνή, [[Rom.7.2|Rom.7:2]] (Polyb., Diod., al.).†
(AS)

G5236.def:
**ὑπερ-βολή**, -ῆς, ἡ
(ὑπερβάλλω), [in LXX: καθ᾽ ὑ., [[4Ma.3.18|4Ma.3:18]] * ;]
a throwing beyond. Metaphorical, **excess, superiority, excellence**: [[2Co.4.7; 12.7|2Co.4:7 12:7]]; καθ᾽ ὑπερβολήν, beyond measure, exceedingly, [[Rom.7.13|Rom.7:13]], [[1Co.12.31|1Co.12:31]], [[2Co.1.8|2Co.1:8]], [[Gal.1.13|Gal.1:13]]; κ. ὑ. εἰς ὑ., beyond all measure, [[2Co.4.17|2Co.4:17]]†
(AS)

G5206.def:
**υἱοθεσία**, -ας, ἡ
(cf. the cl. phrases, υἱὸν τίθεσθαι, θετὸς υἱός), frequently in Inscr. (see Deiss., BS, 239), adoption of a son (or daughter); metaphorically, of God's relation established
(a) **with Israel**: [[Rom.9.4|Rom.9:4]]
(b) **with Christ­ians**: [[Rom.8.15|Rom.8:15]], [[Gal.4.5|Gal.4:5]], [[Eph.1.5|Eph.1:5]]; of its consummation, [[Rom.8.23|Rom.8:23]]†
(AS)

G5241.def:
**ὑπερ-εν-τυγχάνω **
**to intercede or make petition for **(see Deiss., BS, 121 f.): before ὑπέρ, [[Rom.8.26|Rom.8:26]]†
(AS)

G5245.def:
**ὑπερ-νικάω**, -ῶ
[in LXX: Da TH [[Dan.6.3|Dan.6:3]] in Sm.: [[Psa.43.1|Psa.43:1]] * ;]
**to be more than conqueror**: [[Rom.8.37|Rom.8:37]] (eccl.).†
(AS)

G5275.def:
**ὑπο-λείπω **
[in LXX chiefly (pass.) for יָתַר ni., שָׁאַר ni. ;]
**to leave remaining **(Hom., Thuc., al.): pass., of survivors, [[Rom.11.3|Rom.11:3]]†
(AS)

G5252.def:
**ὑπερ-φρονέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX: [[4Ma.13.1|4Ma.13:1]] [[4Mac.14.11|4Mac 14:11]] [[4Mac.16.2|4Mac 16:2]] * ;]
1. **to be overproud, high-minded **(Æsch.): μὴ ὑ. παρ᾽ ὃ δεῖ φρονεῖν (on the paranom., see Vau., in l), [[Rom.12.3|Rom.12:3]]
2. to overlook, think slightly of (Thuc., Plat.).†
(AS)

G5242.def:
**ὑπερ-έχω **
[in LXX: [[Gen.25.23|Gen.25:23]] (אָמַץ), [[Exo.26.13|Exo.26:13]] (עֲדַף), [[Sir.36.7|Sir.36:7]], al. ;]
1. trans., to hold over or above.
2. Intrans. (when a noun follows, the case is governed by the prep.; see Bl., § 34, 1; 36, 8), to rise above, overtop; metaphorically,
(a) to be superior in rank, etc.: [[Rom.13.1|Rom.13:1]], [[1Pe.2.13|1Pe.2:13]] (cf. [[Wis.6.6|Wis.6:6]]);
(b) **to be superior, excel, surpass**: with genitive (cl.; see supr.), [[Php.2.3|Php.2:3]] with accusative (cl.; see supr.), [[Php.4.7|Php.4:7]] as subst., τ. ὑπερέχον, the excel­lency, the surpassing worth, [[Php.3.8|Php.3:8]]†
(AS)

G5294.def:
**ὑπο-τίθημι **
[in LXX for שׂוּם, etc. ;]
to place under, lay down. Metaphorical, τ. τράχηλον ὑποθεῖναι, **to risk one's life **(see Deiss., _LAE_, 119 f.): [[Rom.16.4|Rom.16:4]] mid., **to suggest**: [[1Ti.4.6|1Ti.4:6]]†
(AS)

G5247.def:
**ὑπεροχή**, -ῆς, ἡ
(ὑπερέχω) [in LXX: [[Jer.52.22|Jer.52:22]] (קוֹמָה), [[2Ma.3.11|2Ma.3:11]], al. ;]
a projection, eminence, as the peak of a mountain. Metaphorical (Arist.), **excellence, pre-eminence**: λόγου ἢ σοφίας, [[1Co.2.1|1Co.2:1]] οἱ ἐν ὑ (for a parallel to this phrase, see Deiss., BS, 255, and cf. 2Mac, l.with), [[1Ti.2.2|1Ti.2:2]]†
(AS)

G5297.def:
**ὑπο-φέρω **
[in LXX for נָשָׂא, etc. ;]
to bear by being under. Metaphorical, **to endure**: with accusative of thing(s), [[1Co.10.13|1Co.10:13]], [[2Ti.3.11|2Ti.3:11]], [[1Pe.2.19|1Pe.2:19]].†
(AS)

G5235.def:
**ὑπερ-βάλλω **
[in LXX: [[Job.15.11|Job.15:11]] A (†), [[Sir.5.7; 25.11|Sir.5:7 25:11]], al. ;]
1. trans., to throw over or beyond.
2. Intrans., to run beyond. In both senses, metaphorically, **to exceed, surpass, transcend**: [[2Co.3.10; 9.14|2Co.3:10 9:14]], [[Eph.1.19; 2.7|Eph.1:19 2:7]]; with genitive obj., [[Eph.3.19|Eph.3:19]]†
(AS)

G5287.def:
**ὑπό-στασις**, -εως, ἡ
(ὑφίστημι, to set under, stand under, support) [in LXX for מַצָּב ([[1Ki.13.23; 14.4|1Ki.13:23 14:4]] B), תִּקְוָה ([[Rut.1.12|Rut.1:12]], [[Ezk.19.5|Eze.19:5]]), etc., also in [[Wis.16.21|Wis.16:21]] ;]
1. a support, base or foundation (in various senses).
2. **substance **(Arist., al.; opposite to φαντασία, ἔμφασις): [[Heb.1.3|Heb.1:3]]
3. steadiness, firmness (Polyb., al.), **hence, assurance, confidence**: [[2Co.9.4; 11.17|2Co.9:4 11:17]], [[Heb.3.14; 11.1|Heb.3:14 11:1]] (here perhaps title-deed, as that which gives reality or guarantee; see MM, xxv).†
(AS)

G5238.def:
**ὑπερ-έκεινα **
comp. adv. (see Bl., 28, 2; M, _Pr._, 99),
**beyond**: as prep. with genitive, τὰ ὑ. ὑμῶν, [[2Co.10.16|2Co.10:16]] (Byz. and [[Ecc.1.1-18|Ecc.1:1-18]]).†
(AS)

G5229.def:
**ὑπερ-αίρω **
[in LXX: [[2Ch.32.23|2Ch.32:23]] (נָשָׂא ni.), etc. ;]
to lift or raise over. Mid., **to uplift oneself**: [[2Co.12.7|2Co.12:7]] before ἐπί, with accusative, of person(s), [[2Th.2.4|2Th.2:4]] (cf. [[2Ma.5.23|2Ma.5:23]]).†
(AS)

G5231.def:
**ὑπερ-άνω **
_compound adv._, [in LXX for עַל, מֵעָל, etc. ;]
**above**: as prep. with genitive, [[Eph.1.21; 4.10|Eph.1:21 4:10]], [[Heb.9.5|Heb.9:5]].†
(AS)

G5251.def:
**ὑπερ-υψόω**, -ῶ
[in LXX: [[Psa.37.35|Psa.37:35]] (עָרִיץ) [[Psa.97.9|Psa.97:9]] (עָלָה ni.), Da TH [[Dan.4.34; 11.12|Dan.4:34 11:12]] (רוּם), ib. LXX TH [[Dan.3.52|Dan.3:52]] ff.* ;]
1. **to exalt beyond measure, exalt to the highest place**: [[Php.2.9|Php.2:9]]
2. to extol (Da, ll. with).†
(AS)

G5227.def:
**ὑπ-εναντίος**, -α, -ον
[in LXX for אָיַב, צַר, etc. ;]
set over against, opposite. Metaphorical (Plat., Arist., al.), **opposed to, contrary to**: with dative of person(s), [[Col.2.14|Col.2:14]] absol., as subst., ὁ ὑ., [[Heb.10.27|Heb.10:27]] (cf. [[Isa.26.11|Isa.26:11]]).†
(AS)

G5233.def:
**ὑπερ-βαίνω **
[in LXX for עָבַר, etc. ;]
1. trans., to step over, trans­gress (R, **overreach**: [[1Th.4.6|1Th.4:6]]).
2. Intrans., **to transgress**: metaphorically, [[1Th.4.6|1Th.4:6]] (R, txt.; see M, _Th._, in l).†
(AS)

G5250.def:
**ὑπερ-πλεονάζω **
**to abound exceedingly**: [[1Ti.1.14|1Ti.1:14]] ([[Pss.5.19|Ps Sol 5:19]] Herm., Mand., v, 2, 5).†
(AS)

G5296.def:
**ὑπο-τύπωσις**, -εως, ἡ
(ὑποτυπόω, to delineate),
an outline, sketch. Metaphorical, **a pattern, example**: [[1Ti.1.16|1Ti.1:16]], [[2Ti.1.13|2Ti.1:13]].†
_SYN._: ὁμοίωμα, τύπος, ὑπόδειγμα (see _DB_, iii, 696b) (AS)

G5202.def:
**ὑδροποτίω**, -ῶ
(ὕδωρ, πίνω), [in LXX: Dan LXX 1:12 שָׁתָה מַיִם) * ;]
to drink water, opposite to οἴνῳ χρῆσθαι: [[1Ti.5.23|1Ti.5:23]] (Hdt., i, 71; Plat., Rep., 561 with, al.).†
(AS)

G5280.def:
**ὑπόμινησις**, -εως, ἡ
(ὑπομιμνήσκω) [in LXX: [[Psa.71.6|Psa.71:6]] א (תְּהִלָּה), [[Wis.16.11|Wis.16:11]], [[2Ma.6.17|2Ma.6:17]] * ;]
**a reminding, reminder**: ἐν ὑ., [[2Pe.1.13; 3.1|2Pe.1:13 3:1]]; with genitive, [[2Ti.1.5|2Ti.1:5]]†
(AS)

G5289.def:
**ὑπο-στολή**, -ῆς, ἡ
(ὑποστέλλω),
1. a letting down, lowering (Plut.).
2. **a shrinking back **(Hesych.): οὐκ ἐσμὲν ὑποστολῆς (on the genitive, see Bl., § 35, 2), [[Heb.10.39|Heb.10:39]]†
(AS)

G5226.def:
**ὑπ-είκω **
[in LXX: [[4Ma.6.35|4Ma.6:35]] * ;]
1. to retire, withdraw.
2. **to yield, submit**: metaphorically, [[Heb.13.17|Heb.13:17]]†
(AS)

G5208.def:
**ὕλη**, -ης, ἡ
[in LXX: [[Job.19.29|Job.19:29]] (†) [[Job.38.40|Job.38:40]] (סֻכָּה), [[Psa.69.2|Psa.69:2]] B.l א (יָוֵן), [[Isa.10.17|Isa.10:17]] (שָׁמִיר), [[Wis.11.17; 15.13|Wis.11:17 15:13]], [[Sir.28.10|Sir.28:10]], [[2Ma.2.24|2Ma.2:24]], [[4Ma.1.29|4Ma.1:29]] * ;]
1. wood, forest, woodland (Thus., Xen., al.).
2. **wood, timber, fuel **(Hom., Hdt., Thuc., al.): [[Jas.3.5|Jas.3:5]] (see Hort, _Ja._, 70, 104 f.).
3. = Lat. materia, esp. in Philosophy, matter (Arist. and later writers; Wis, ll. with).†
(AS)

G5277.def:
**ὑπο-λιμτάνω **
collat. form of ὑπολείπω,
**to leave behind**: [[1Pe.2.21|1Pe.2:21]]†
(AS)

G5261.def:
**ὑπογραμμός**, -οῦ, ὁ
(ὑπογράφω, (a) to write under; (b) to trace letters for copying), [in LXX: [[2Ma.2.28|2Ma.2:28]] * ;]
1. **a writing-copy, hence, **
2. **an example**: [[1Pe.2.11|1Pe.2:11]] (Philo).†
(AS)

G5246.def:
**ὑπέρ-ογκος**, -ον
[in LXX: [[Deu.30.11|Deu.30:11]] (פָּלָא), etc. ;]
**of excessive weight or size**; metaphorically, excessive, immoderate, in late writers, of arrogant speech (see Mayor on Ju, l.with): n. pl., [[2Pe.2.18|2Pe.2:18]], [[Jude.16|Ju 16]].†
(AS)

G5254.def:
**ὑπ-έχω **
[in LXX: [[Psa.89.50|Psa.89:50]] (נָשָׂא), [[Lam.5.7|La 5:7]] (סָבַל), [[Wis.12.21|Wis.12:21]], [[2Ma.4.48|2Ma.4:48]] * ;]
to hold or put under. Metaphorical, **to undergo, suffer**: δίκην, [[Jude.7|Ju 7]] (Soph., Eur., al.).†
(AS)
